injection_record_actual_fields_check.name: injection_record_actual_fields_check
injection_record_actual_fields_check.value:
(
        "injection_record"."status" = 'completed'
        and "injection_record"."actual_date" is not null
        and "injection_record"."actual_time" is not null
        and "injection_record"."actual_dose_amount" > 0
        and char_length("injection_record"."actual_dose_unit") between 1 and 20
      ) or (
        "injection_record"."status" in ('skipped', 'missed')
        and "injection_record"."actual_date" is null
        and "injection_record"."actual_time" is null
        and "injection_record"."actual_dose_amount" is null
        and "injection_record"."actual_dose_unit" is null
        and "injection_record"."injection_site_id" is null
      )

member_protocol_provenance_check.name: member_protocol_provenance_check
member_protocol_provenance_check.value:
(
        "member_protocol"."origin" = 'custom'
        and "member_protocol"."source_template_id" is null
        and "member_protocol"."source_template_version_id" is null
        and "member_protocol"."template_schedule_unchanged" = false
      ) or (
        "member_protocol"."origin" = 'template'
        and "member_protocol"."source_template_id" is not null
        and "member_protocol"."source_template_version_id" is not null
      )

protocol_cycle_template_reference_check.name: protocol_cycle_template_reference_check
protocol_cycle_template_reference_check.value:
(
        "protocol_cycle"."source_template_id" is null
        and "protocol_cycle"."source_template_version_id" is null
        and "protocol_cycle"."template_initially_matching" = false
        and "protocol_cycle"."first_deviated_on" is null
      ) or (
        "protocol_cycle"."source_template_id" is not null
        and "protocol_cycle"."source_template_version_id" is not null
      )

protocol_cycle_goal_baseline_snapshot_ch.name: protocol_cycle_goal_baseline_snapshot_check
protocol_cycle_goal_baseline_snapshot_ch.value:
(
        "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_status" = 'missing'
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_source_type" = 'none'
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_source_id" is null
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_value" is null
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_unit" is null
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_observed_on" is null
      ) or (
        "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_status" in ('valid', 'unsuitable')
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_source_type" in ('measurement', 'check_in')
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_source_id" is not null
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_value" is not null
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_unit" is not null
        and "protocol_cycle_goal"."baseline_observed_on" is not null
      )

symptom_record_description_check.name: symptom_record_description_check
symptom_record_description_check.value: ("symptom_record"."symptom_id" = 'custom' and char_length("symptom_record"."custom_description") between 1 and 120) or ("symptom_record"."symptom_id" <> 'custom' and ("symptom_record"."custom_description" is null or char_length("symptom_record"."custom_description") <= 120))

symptom_record_time_check.name: symptom_record_time_check
symptom_record_time_check.value: "symptom_record"."started_at" is null or "symptom_record"."ended_at" is null or "symptom_record"."ended_at" >= "symptom_record"."started_at"

user_display_name_length_check.name: user_display_name_length_check
user_display_name_length_check.value: "user"."display_name" is null or char_length("user"."display_name") between 1 and 60
